name: Mixed Feelings: Elysium
source:
Following the events of [url=https://vndb.org/v29364]Mixed Feelings[/url],  Elysium brings you down the same river you've been down again, again, and again. However, this time, you decide to take a turn, finding yourself on the opposite end of Asphodel Meadows.

Upon meeting either Ezra, Zale, and Dandy, you discover that you don't remember who you are, where you came from, or why you're even there. The story unfolds as the residents of the town try and help you remember, and you learn what it truly means to be yourself.

[From [url=https://spoonycatt.itch.io/mixed-feelings-elysium]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
继 [url=https://vndb.org/v29364]Mixed Feelings[/url] 事件之后，《Elysium》将带你一次又一次地沿着同一条河流滑下去。然而，这一次，你决定转弯，发现自己位于Asphodel Meadows的另一端。

见到以斯拉、扎尔和丹迪后，你发现自己不记得自己是谁、从哪里来、甚至不记得为什么会在那里。故事随着镇上的居民试图帮助你记忆而展开，你也了解到做自己的真正意义。

[来自[url=https://spoonycatt.itch.io/mixed-feelings-elysium]Itch.io[/url]]
